name.note: Tracked the MSCI Australia 200 Index until 1 Dec 2015 (BlackRock), when it switched to the S&P/ASX 200; no recent name change found.

index.note: Benchmark changed from the MSCI Australia 200 Index on 1 Dec 2015.

mer.note: Management fee as stated in the PDS

yield.note: BlackRock's '12m Trailing Yield' at 15 Oct 2026: all income distributions with ex-dates in the past 12 months (8 Oct 2026, 1 Jul 2026, 9 Apr 2026, 7 Jan 2026; A$1.2266 a unit in total) divided by the latest NAV. The September 2026 fact sheet showed 3.40% at 30 Sep 2026. Excludes franking credits.

franking.note: BlackRock's 'Franking Level of distributed income' for the year ended 30 Jun 2026 (Tax Summary tab of the product page; BlackRock labels these figures estimates). Franking credits that year were 35.56 cents a unit on 121.15 cents of cash distributions.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (first unit creation); listed on the ASX 9 Dec 2010
